retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist composition featuring a bold diagonal red brushstroke overlaid with black geometric symbols and thin, elegant serif typography on a stark white background.
excludeWhen: symmetrical or centered layouts are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, asymmetrical layout centered around a textured, diagonal red paint stroke. The stroke is overlaid with black glyphs, brackets, and circles. Fine-lined serif text is placed in the corners to create balance, while a small blue accent stroke appears at the bottom right.
coreVisualRelationships: Bold red diagonal stroke as the primary visual anchor
Black geometric symbols providing a structured contrast to the organic paint texture
Corner-aligned typography creating a diagonal tension across the white space
Small blue accent stroke balancing the dominant red and black palette
coreInvariants: Textured, dry-brush edges on the paint strokes
High-contrast black ink for all symbols and text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main red stroke is centrally located but angled diagonally from bottom-left to top-right, occupying approximately 40% of the canvas width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large black 'O' with a slash (null symbol) located on the left side of the red stroke.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-right text, follows the diagonal red stroke down to the center symbols, and ends at the bottom-right text and blue stroke.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space surrounds the central elements, emphasizing the minimalism.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white background for maximum contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant primary red for the main gestural stroke.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep black for typography and symbols; small cerulean blue stroke for a secondary accent.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation red and blue against neutral black and white.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast with very thin hairlines
Slightly irregular, hand-drawn quality to the serifs
characterSpecificRedesigns: The '1' has a long, curved top hook
The '9' and '2' feature elegant, sweeping curves
The '7' has a sharp, angled descent
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: The elegant serif text is paired with bold, geometric symbols (circles, brackets, arrows) to create a tension between classical and modern aesthetics.

candidateDirections.reason: To match the high-contrast, elegant serif skeleton.
To capture the slight irregularities and organic feel of the original.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a stark white background with a single, thick, textured red brushstroke running diagonally from middle-left to middle-right. Add a very small, thin blue brushstroke in the bottom-right corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay black geometric symbols (slashed circle, brackets, chevrons) onto the red stroke. Add fine-lined, elegant serif numbers in the top-right and text in the bottom-right using a hand-inked style.

verificationChecks: Does the red stroke have visible dry-brush textures?
Are the black symbols sharp and high-contrast?
Is the typography placed in the corners to create diagonal balance?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is overlapping the red stroke in a way that reduces legibility.
Verify the blue stroke is significantly smaller than the red stroke.
Check that the white space feels intentional and expansive.
Confirm the symbols look like ink on paper rather than digital vectors.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [gestural paint stroke] + [geometric symbol overlay] + [corner-aligned high-contrast serif typography] on [stark white negative space].
